findings.F1: The tested rise side has no continuation to find. In the shown folds B and C, the tested cases (forecast > 0, 3-day grid) average -0.41 % excess over 3 days (t -0.75, 184 cases), matching step 5's -0.085 % (t -0.29). They also flip sign by year: 2018 -2.77 % (t -3.41), 2019 -1.54 % (t -2.21), 2020 +2.07 % (t 1.65), 2021 +0.35 % (t 0.29).
findings.F2: Recomputed from prices, choppy-market five-day rises stay flat over 3 days, -0.45 % excess (t -0.62, 116 cases). Size does not help: the largest scaled-rise quintile gives +1.36 % (t 0.79, 13 cases) against -1.33 % (t -1.20) for the next one, so the rise side is not graded.
findings.F3: The continuation shows on the mirror side, which the brief names ("up or down"). In a choppy market, five-day falls are followed by a further 3-day excess fall of -2.41 % (t -1.82, 102 cases on 64 days) and by -4.50 % over 5 days (t -1.85, 61 cases).
findings.F4: That choppy-fall continuation is graded by the scaled fall, as the brief claims:
findings.F5: The choppy-fall continuation holds across the sample. All six coins are negative over 3 days (from ZEC -0.63 % to XRP -3.07 %, t -2.10), and all four years are negative (2018 -5.33 %, 2019 -0.99 %, 2020 -3.78 %, 2021 -1.01 %).
findings.F6: The rising-market contrast in the brief shows on falls. In rising markets, five-day falls are followed by +0.53 % (t 0.48, 203 cases) instead of continuation. In falling markets the continuation is weaker and not monotone in size: -1.26 % (t -1.38, 407 cases) overall, with quintile 3 at -3.53 % (t -2.58) but the largest quintile at -1.04 %.
findings.F7: Its size against the cost: a 3-day choppy-fall case moves about -2.4 % beyond the drift, and about -2.1 % in total after the coin's +0.35 % 3-day drift works against a short. That is roughly 11 times the 0.19 % cost of a trade. The tested rise side's total move was +0.07 %, 0.4 times the cost.

ideas.idea: In a choppy market, after a five-day fall, a coin falls further over the next 3 days, more so the larger its 5-day fall in units of its 30-day daily-return swing.
ideas.consequence: In a choppy market, a five-day fall that is large for the coin's own swing is a reason to be short for the next few days rather than to buy the dip.
ideas.name: choppy scaled fall continuation
